heading: Outgoing requests
body: HTTPClient marks a client class and optionally sets its base path. GetRequest sends GET. PostRequest sends POST. PutRequest sends PUT. PatchRequest sends PATCH. DeleteRequest sends DELETE. StreamRequest keeps a stream of server-sent events open, the partner of StreamRoute: its one parameter is the message model, and Tachyon passes each message to the method and publishes it as that model's event. Each method path follows the class path. PathVariable fills a path value, such as {id}. RequestParam adds a query value after ?. RequestBody sends the JSON body. RequestHeader adds a request header. Keep marked method bodies empty; Tachyon builds the request. Browser JavaScript and TypeScript use owner-bound transport. Other languages need an explicitly configured adapter. A URL with a host must name a host in tac.outgoing.hosts (page code) or outgoing.hosts in server/application.json (Yon code). Tachyon refuses other hosts when it builds (TY1326) and when it runs.
